I replied to Pree in her #central-team thread. I told her I'd noted that the signed order form for Tansley Parcel is due 25 August. I didn't take any other action, as she asked.

I also pointed out that the date looks wrong. Her message was sent on 14 October 2026, so if she meant 25 August this year, that deadline has already passed. I asked her to send the right date if that's a mistake. I couldn't check it myself because I found no Tansley Parcel account files.
